display_name: Crescens, companion of Quadratus of Corinth

names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 10 Μαρτίου, «Άγιοι Κοδράτος, Ανεκτός, Παύλος, Διονύσιος, Κυπριανός και Κρήσκης», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the body of the Ohrid Prologue's first entry for the Julian 10 March on pravoslavno.rs, „То беху Кипријан, Дионисије, Анект, Павле и Крискент.“, which names the five companions; this man's own name is taken out of it. The clause carries no rank word and no epithet, so the bare forename is all it gives him.
Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 10 марта ст. ст., «Крискент Коринфский, мч.», with the rank word left off.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 марта ст. ст. — «Мчч. Кодрата и иже с ним: … Крискента … и иных многих (258)»

attestations.note: The line enumerates twenty-two names and closes «и иных многих»; the quotation is elided to its head, this man's name as the line declines it, and the line's own year. The line's 258 and the life page's reign of Decius (249-251) disagree, and the interval this folder already holds, 249-259, contains both; nothing was narrowed.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 10ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιοι Κοδράτος, Ανεκτός, Παύλος, Διονύσιος, Κυπριανός και Κρήσκης»

attestations.note: The page enumerates the six friends and puts their martyrdom at Corinth «κατά τον διωγμό των αυτοκρατόρων Δεκίου (249-251 μ.Χ.) ή Ουαλεριανού (253-259 μ.Χ.)», under the governor of Greece Jason, leaving the choice of persecution open. It quotes the Menologion of Basil II for Quadratus's birth in the mountains and gives Dionysius a paragraph of his own, in which he is stabbed with a knife rather than beheaded. It prints a distich for each pair of them and gives no year. The page's line writes him Κρήσκης and the body of the page once Κρήσκος, while the distich and the apolytikion decline him Κρήσκεντα, Κρήσκεντι.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 23.03.2026 (10. март ст. ст.) — „Свети мученик Кодрат Коринтски и други с њим.“ … „То беху Кипријан, Дионисије, Анект, Павле и Крискент.“

attestations.note: The day's first entry, whose heading names Quadratus and „и други с њим“. His own name is in the body's own naming clause, which the citation carries after the heading, as the twelve of the Julian 16 February did. `Крискент` is held by no other folder. This folder already holds a `death` of 249 to 259 from saint.gr, and the Prologue's 250 falls inside it and is narrower, so the interval was not narrowed.

death.note: saint.gr: «μαρτύρησαν κατά τον διωγμό των αυτοκρατόρων Δεκίου (249-251 μ.Χ.) ή Ουαλεριανού (253-259 μ.Χ.) στην Κόρινθο, όταν ηγεμόνας της Ελλάδος ήταν ο Ιάσων». The page names no year and leaves the two persecutions as alternatives, so the interval is both reigns it prints.
